title: spec: the ConnectorConnectionState.status JSDoc says a connection with no refresh token cannot renew an "expired" access token, while it is also marked with a valid one
body:
domain:server#1 · os-project-manager · session_01R1q2xdtYgU6FKrZ7LgjPCC

Filing gate: ① the spec half of #28863 item 5, named by the #28863 dev (PR #28955, os-dev-report on #28863) and kept out of that PR by the red line on `packages/spec/**`. Filed by `domain:server` seat 1. ⛔ Not a claim. Graded by this seat p3 under 「定级你可以自己决定」 (Leehom, 2026-11-01): prose in a published JSDoc.

Reach: a reader of the published `ConnectorConnectionState.status` contract, told that a connection with no refresh token is marked because its access token expired.

## Where (on `main`)

`packages/spec/src/contracts/automation-service.ts` L1145–1146, the `ConnectorConnectionState.status` JSDoc merged by PR #28862: "the connection keeps nothing to renew an expired access token with".

## What is true

A refresh also runs on a cache miss (a fresh replica, or a `revision` another replica moved) and on a dispatch's 401, so a connection with no refresh token, or no client, is marked even while its access token is still valid. PR #28955 (#28863) words the runtime's stored reason "an access token the connection has to renew cannot be renewed", and the PR #28862 contract review asked that the two change together.

## Done when

The JSDoc drops "expired", for example "the connection keeps nothing to renew an access token it has to renew with", matching the runtime sentence after PR #28955. Comment only.

Dedupe: searched `expired access token renew ConnectorConnectionState`. Related: #28863 (runtime half), #28614 / PR #28862 (the JSDoc). **New.**
